summary.text: Aleta Moriarty is standing as an independent for Western Victoria Region in the 2026 Legislative Council election. Her campaign site says she is chief executive of the Centre for Sustainability and formerly ran the Human Rights Arts and Film Festival, after a career that took in the United Nations, the World Bank and humanitarian programs in more than twenty countries. She says she grew up in rural Australia as the child of refugees, holds a master's degree from the University of Cambridge and is near the end of a doctorate at the University of Melbourne.

Human Rights Arts and Film Festival

summary.text: Timothy Denton is second in an unnamed group of independents (H) for Western Victoria Region, headed by Aleta Moriarty, in the Legislative Council at the 2026 Victorian election, on the VEC's list of nominations. Moriarty's campaign site names the running mate as Dr Timothy Denton but gives no other details. No other published biography was found as at 10 Nov 2026.

summary.text: Timothy Gooden heads the Socialist Alliance ticket for Western Victoria Region in the 2026 Legislative Council election, ahead of Sue Bull and Ross Smith. He once served as secretary of Geelong Trades Hall and was a CFMEU organiser and shop steward in the construction union, and the party calls him a longstanding socialist and campaigner for Palestine. He led the Victorian Socialists' Western Victoria ticket at the 2018 state election.

previous_candidacies.note: Wikipedia's results list a Socialist Alliance candidate named Tim Gooden in Corio (Geelong); same name and party, but no source we read says it was him.
Wikipedia's results list Tim Gooden second on the Socialist Alliance's Victorian Senate ticket; same name and party, but no source we read says it was him.

summary.text: Vaughan Williams is a One Nation candidate for Western Victoria Region in the 2026 Legislative Council election. Wikipedia's candidate list puts this candidate second on the party's ticket, behind Chris Burson. One Nation Victoria's website refused our requests, so no biography was available to us as at early November 2026.
